name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.35.0: features page rebuilt around the three things an operator actually asks, and a real fix to the revenue chart. The page was an info dump - six feature cards, a four-column alert block, a roles table and an integrations strip, about 1,100 words with no focus. It is now three bands, sales then stock then restocking, one real screenshot each and three lines of text, 406 words. The integrations strip is gone: it advertised a Nayax integration that does not operate (every endpoint returns NAYAX_TOKEN not set and the dashboard column is hidden behind a Nayax-on-hold rule) and named Weimi, which is an internal data dependency no prospect cares about. THE CHART FIX APPLIES TO THE LIVE DASHBOARD: .bc shrink-wrapped to its axis label, so the bar's percentage height resolved against an auto-height parent and every bar computed to zero - the revenue chart drew axis labels and a summary line and no bars at all, on the dashboard and on machine detail alike. Bars now sit in a .bt track stretched to the column, and the label row has a reserved height so labelled and unlabelled columns share a baseline. Both charts verified rendering, 30 bars, 3-64px in an 80px track. Screenshots are now taken against the real backend on a throwaway database, because orders, reports, trends and machine detail all read from the API and render Backend offline on demo data. That database is seeded from the shipped production seed, which is the real customer list, so it is anonymised first - names, addresses, emails, operator ids and device serials - and every capture is checked against a pristine copy of that seed. Cumulative over v6.34.2.
